literal: Those things planned, in the very manner planned, they will attain, those who planned, if they possess to be firm-minded.
translation: Those who have planned an action will achieve exactly what they planned, in the very way they intended, if they possess firmness of mind.
modern: எண்ணியவர்கள் மனவலிமை உடையவர்களாக இருக்கப் பெற்றால், அவர்கள் எண்ணியவற்றை எண்ணியவாறே அடைவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of determination and firmness of mind in achieving one's goals. The poet states that if those who plan a task possess unwavering resolve, they will achieve exactly what they intended, in the precise manner they envisioned it. The repetition of the root word for thinking highlights the direct connection between the initial plan and the final achievement. The condition of being firm-minded is presented as the ultimate key that turns thoughts into reality.
